tracks.conclusion: The English brightness noun is inherited through Germanic; it is not borrowed from Latin.

tracks.precision_note: lumière descends through luminaria/luminare/lumen. lux is a related Latin member of the broader *leuk- family, not an intermediate stage in lumière.

tracks.conclusion: The Chinese history belongs to an instrument-and-sound system independent of the Indo-European light family.

cross_track_conclusion: No historical cognacy or borrowing is established between English light and Chinese 籟/籁. English light and the Latin forms meet only at the deeper reconstructed PIE *leuk- family level; English is not derived from Latin lumen or lux.
